partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Mutant-form GOF driver inhibition
results.hypothesis: A drug can treat a GOF disease when both its direct binding and decreased-activity assertions explicitly target the mutant form of the causal driver.
results.body: mutant-qualified binding and activity inhibition of a Gene2Phenotype GOF driver
results.mechanism_rationale: The pharmacologic and disease edges independently agree on mutant target form and causal direction, providing mutation-specific intervention evidence.
results.trapi_notes: Mutant binding, mutant activity inhibition, and the variant-qualified disease edge are TRAPI-expressible; disease ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[binding:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->
      (driver:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(driver)
MATCH (driver)-[association:ASSOCIATED_WITH]->(object:Disease)
WHERE binding.object_form_or_variant_qualifier = 'mutant_form'
  AND effect.object_form_or_variant_qualifier = 'mutant_form'
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND 'infores:gene2phenotype' IN
      coalesce(association.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND association.subject_form_or_variant_qualifier =
      'gain_of_function_variant_form'
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Mutant-form GOF driver activation control
results.hypothesis: Increasing activity of a mutant GOF driver is the matched worsening control.
results.body: R387 with mutant driver activity increased
results.mechanism_rationale: The same mutation-specific evidence is retained, but the pharmacologic direction reinforces the GOF mechanism.
